records.name: Riau Islands
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score.

records.name: East Kalimantan
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier. It is one of the eight provinces documented in an international NGO's analysis of discriminatory provincial regulations (province, district and city laws overlapping national law), so a legal divergence exists, but no incident documentation was found for this unit and no deviation from the national position was material enough to score separately; it is therefore assessed at the national score.
